TorrentCreator

Core functionality for creating torrent files with optimal settings.

class TorrentCreator(config)[source]

Bases: object

Creates torrent files with optimal settings for both single files and directories.

This class handles the core torrent creation functionality, including: - Optimal piece size calculation - File filtering (hidden files, system files) - Progress reporting - Torrent verification

Parameters:

config (TorrentConfig) – Configuration for torrent creation

__init__(config)[source]

Initialize the torrent creator.

Parameters:

config (TorrentConfig) – Configuration for torrent creation

create(input_path, output_path)[source]

Create a torrent file from a file or directory.

Parameters:

  • input_path (str | Path) – Path to the file or directory to create a torrent from

  • output_path (str) – Path where to save the torrent file

Returns:

Path to the created torrent file

Return type:

str

Raises:

  • ValueError – If input path does not exist

  • OSError – If there are issues reading files or writing the torrent

  • RuntimeError – If torrent creation fails

calculate_optimal_piece_size(total_size)[source]

Calculate the optimal piece size for a torrent based on its total size.

The piece size affects both the torrent file size and client memory usage: - Smaller pieces allow more granular downloading but increase torrent file size - Larger pieces reduce overhead but require more sequential downloading - Aim for 1000-2000 pieces total as a balance for most clients

Parameters:

total_size (int) – Total size of the content in bytes

Returns:

Optimal piece size in bytes (power of 2 between min and max bounds)

Return type:

int

static verify_torrent_file(torrent_path)[source]

Verify that a torrent file is valid and can be loaded.

Parameters:

torrent_path (str) – Path to the torrent file

Returns:

True if the torrent file is valid

Return type:

bool

Note

This method attempts to decode the torrent file to ensure it’s valid. It does not verify the actual content or piece hashes.

Manages the manifest file for tracking processed directories.

__init__(output_dir=None, use_cache=True, cache_size=None, preload_cache=True)[source]

Initialize the manifest manager.

Parameters:

  • output_dir (str | None) – Directory where manifest file should be stored. If None, uses current directory.

  • use_cache (bool) – Whether to use in-memory caching (default: True)

  • cache_size (int | None) – Maximum number of entries to cache (None for unlimited)

  • preload_cache (bool) – Whether to preload all entries into cache at startup (default: True)
